Added [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L1562-L1571) and [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L1728-L1735) methods on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L582-L633) to serialize and deserialize both shapes and the full spatial index cell structure without rebuilding.

### Summary of Changes
- **[`s2/shapeindex.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go)**:
  - Implemented [`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L1562-L1571) to trigger [`Build`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L792-L794) if pending updates exist, then write the encoding version, `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, shape entries with preserved shape IDs, and the ordered spatial index cells ([`ShapeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L108-L110) and [`clippedShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L73-L85) entries).
  - Supported round-trip serialization for all built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shape.go#L184-L269) types (`*Polygon`, `*Polyline`, `*PointVector`, `*LaxPolyline`, `*LaxPolygon`, `*Loop`, `*LaxLoop`, as well as generic `Shape` implementations).
  - Implemented [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex.go#L1728-L1735) with bounds and invariant validation against truncated streams, corrupted data, and oversized allocation counts, marking the decoded index as `fresh` so queries and iterators work immediately without calling `Build`.
  - Updated `applyUpdatesInternal` and `makeIndexCell` to use `s.nextID` when indexing shapes with non-contiguous IDs.
- **[`s2/encode.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/encode.go)**, **[`s2/polyline.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/polyline.go)**, **[`s2/polygon.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/polygon.go)**:
  - Added [`decoder.readInt32`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/encode.go#L174-L180) and fixed error propagation in [`Polyline.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/polyline.go#L380-L402) and [`Polygon.decodeCompressed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/polygon.go#L1183-L1209).
- **[`s2/lax_loop.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/lax_loop.go)**, **[`s2/lax_polygon.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/lax_polygon.go)**, **[`s2/shapeutil_edge_iterator.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeutil_edge_iterator.go)**, **[`s2/crossing_edge_query.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/crossing_edge_query.go)**:
  - Fixed chain edge/position indexing in [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/lax_loop.go#L74-L80) and [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/lax_polygon.go#L206-L221), and updated [`EdgeIterator`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeutil_edge_iterator.go#L54-L72) and [`CrossingEdgeQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/crossing_edge_query.go#L196-L206) to handle sparse shape IDs.
- **[`s2/shapeindex_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rob8htjv/s2/shapeindex_test.go)**:
  - Added unit tests covering empty index encoding, all built-in shape types, zero-edge shapes, mixed chain counts, non-sequential shape IDs, unbuilt index encoding, and malformed/truncated/oversized inputs.
